newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes higher, near record.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes higher, near record.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks roared back on Friday to close within reach of a new high after producer price data for September indicated moderate economic growth.

The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 11.20 points, or 0.91 percent, at 1248.17 at its unofficial close, while advances led declining issues by 2099 to 1857 on volume of about 539 million shares. The Composite's record closing high is 1250.87, which it hit on October 7.
The rally ended a three-session losing streak related in part to preannouncements of disappointing third quarter results.

Friday's disaster of the day was Cascade Communications Corp, which tumbled 15-1/8 to 71-3/8 and topped the over-the-counter most active list. The company reported earnings, which exceeded Wall Street expectations, but did not far exceed those of the prior period, sparking the sell-off.
Intel Corp was up 5-1/2 at 105-3/8. Morgan Stanley upgared the stock to strong buy from outperform.

Ascend Communications Inc was up one at 65-3/8 after SoundView Financial Group and Hambrecht & Quist both raised their 1996 and 1997 earnings per share view for the company. -- Wall Street desk 212-859-1737
